examples.name: Sample — blanks inside bulleted sentences
paragraphs: Each bullet is a sentence with one percentage blank in it; the indented group prints a short label, =, then the blank. The page also carries a three-row table whose last column is an unlabelled tick box.

examples.name: Sample — hints printed inside the blanks
paragraphs: Executed on the (date) ___ day of (month) ___ (year) ___: the hints sit before each blank, in blue italic. Print Your Name: and Your Signature: are ordinary labelled fill-ins; the (If any) hint of Lawyer Signature: stays beside its blank.

examples.name: Sample — captions printed under the line
paragraphs: A notarial block where the caption is set in small capitals beneath each dotted line — NAME, DATE, SIGNATURE OF DEPONENT — and a fee line that prints $ before its blank. A standalone line takes its caption as its label, with no colon because the two sit on different lines; the NAME line inside the sentence keeps its caption right after its blank.
